entries: {the_someone} had died at {landmark} years ago, and had never left.
{CLOSE:human} had opened the door to it {MANNER}, out of {MOTIVE}.
{the_thing:!living} was not keeping it out; {the_thing:!living} was calling it in.
The {rival} fed it every winter, out of {MOTIVE}, and {first} was this year's offering.
{the_disaster:strikes} was meant to cure {place}, and it had failed.
The voice in {landmark} was {first}'s own, left there {MANNER} on a night {first} forgot.
{the_someone} was the only thing in {place} still human.
Every warning had come from {the_someone}, who was trying to keep {first} alive.
{first} had been missing since {DISASTER:strikes}, and {place} had stopped looking.
{the_thing:portable} had been passed to {first} {MANNER}, to carry the curse away from {CLOSE:human}.
Nothing came from {landmark}; {SOMEONE:!plural} came from under {place}, and the {rival} knew.
